provenance.kind: original exact model and seeded actual tabular TD
provenance.license: MIT for generator; original teaching diagrams

world.reward: success indicator only on entering either terminal door
world.observation: visible position; cue only at C; terminal success/failure is observed
world.reset: explicit new episode with independent mode/cue; learned tables persist

anatomy.fixedConstructor: copy position; write posterior on cue; retain it on blank

learning.representation: one-hot (position,cue) for memory; one-hot position for observation baseline
learning.behavior: up at C/M; uniform left/right at J
learning.ratio: 1 at C/M; 2 for target-matching terminal action, otherwise 0
learning.baseline: same transitions, same alpha and question specs; discard cue only
learning.consumer: at J compare learned left/right success answers; ties left; exact evaluation under stated noisy cue model
learning.limit: fixed hand-built recursive state and question specs; small episodic table experiment, not learned state or autonomous question discovery
